غيل');
    btn.title=playing?'إيقاف مؤقت':'تشغيل';
  }
  function formatVideoTime(value){
    const total=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(value)||0));
    const h=Math.floor(total/3600),m=Math.floor((total%3600)/60),sec=total%60;
    return h?`${h}:${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(sec).padStart(2,'0')}`:`${m}:${String(sec).padStart(2,'0')}`;
  }
  function updateVideoProgress(box,player){
    if(!box||!player||!activeVideoReady)return;
    try{
      const duration=Math.max(0,Number(player.getDuration?.())||0);
      const current=Math.max(0,Number(player.getCurrentTime?.())||0);
      const loaded=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,Number(player.getVideoLoadedFraction?.())||0));
      const seek=box.querySelector('[data-vseek]');
      const cur=box.querySelector('[data-vtime]');
      const dur=box.querySelector('[data-vduration]');
      const buffer=box.querySelector('[data-vbuffer]');
      if(seek){seek.max=String(duration||1);if(!activeVideoSeeking)seek.value=String(Math.min(current,duration||current));const pct=duration?Math.max(0,Math.min(100,(Number(seek.value)||0)/duration*100)):0;seek.style.setProperty('--seek-fill',pct+'%');}
      if(cur&&!activeVideoSeeking)cur.textContent=formatVideoTime(current);
      if(dur)dur.textContent=formatVideoTime(duration);
      if(buffer)buffer.style.width=`${Math.round(loaded*10000)/100}%`;
    }catch{}
  }
  function startVideoProgress(box,player){
    if(activeVideoProgressTimer)clearInterval(activeVideoProgressTimer);
    updateVideoProgress(box,player);
    activeVideoProgressTimer=setInterval(()=>{if(activeVideoBox===box&&activeVideoReady)updateVideoProgress(box,player)},250);
  }
  function setQualityBadge(box,quality){
    const btn=box?.querySelector('[data-vquality]');if(!btn)return;
    const labels={small:'240p',medium:'360p',large:'480p',hd720:'720p',hd1080:'1080p',highres:'HD+'};
    btn.textContent=labels[quality]||'HD Auto';
    btn.title=quality?`الجودة الحالية: ${btn.textContent} — اضغط لاختيار 720p/1080p يدويًا`:'اضغط لاختيار 720p/1080p يدويًا';
  }
  async function mountStudyMateVideo(box,id,title){
    stopActiveVideo();activeVideoBox=box;activeVideoReady=false;
    const mountId='sm-yt-'+uid();
    box.innerHTML=`<div class="site-video-crop"><div id="${mountId}" class="site-video-api-target"></div></div><div class="site-video-edge top"></div><div class="site-video-edge bottom"></div><div class="site-video-progress" aria-label="شريط تقدم الفيديو"><span data-vtime>0:00</span><div class="site-video-track"><div class="site-video-buffer" data-vbuffer></div><input data-vseek type="range" min="0" max="1" value="0" step="0.1" aria-label="تقديم أو تأخير الفيديو"></div><span data-vduration>0:00</span></div><button type="button" class="site-video-quality-exit" data-vquality-exit aria-label="العودة للمشغل" title="العودة للمشغل">العودة للمشغل ←</button><div class="site-video-brand"><span>B</span><b>StudyMate Player</b></div><div class="site-video-controls"><button type="button" data-vtoggle aria-label="تشغيل" title="تشغيل">▶</button><button type="button" data-vquality aria-label="أفضل جودة تلقائيًا" title="أفضل جودة تلقائيًا">HD Auto</button><button type="button" data-vfull aria-label="ملء الشاشة" title="ملء الشاشة">⛶</button></div><div class="site-video-loading">جاري تجهيز الفيديو...</div>`;
    box.classList.add('playing');
    try{
      const YT=await loadYouTubeApi();
      if(activeVideoBox!==box)return;
      const playerVars={autoplay:1,controls:1,rel:0,playsinline:1,iv_load_policy:3,disablekb:0,fs:0};
      if(/^https?:$/.test(location.protocol))playerVars.origin=location.origin;
      const player=new YT.Player(mountId,{
        videoId:id,width:1280,height:720,host:'https://www.youtube-nocookie.com',playerVars,
        events:{
          onReady:()=>{
            if(activeVideoBox!==box){try{player.destroy()}catch{};return}
            activeVideoPlayer=player;activeVideoReady=true;
            box.querySelector('.site-video-loading')?.remove();
            try{player.playVideo()}catch{}
            setVideoToggle(box,YT.PlayerState.PLAYING);
            setQualityBadge(box,'');
            startVideoProgress(box,player);
          },
          onStateChange:e=>{if(activeVideoBox===box){setVideoToggle(box,e.data);updateVideoProgress(box,player)}},
          onPlaybackQualityChange:e=>{if(activeVideoBox===box)setQualityBadge(box,e.data)},
          onError:()=>{if(activeVideoBox===box){activeVideoReady=false;box.querySelector('.site-video-loading')?.replaceChildren(document.createTextNode('تعذر تشغيل الفيديو داخل الموقع.'))}}
        }
      });
      activeVideoPlayer=player;
      const syncHdScale=()=>{
        if(box.classList.contains('native-quality-mode'))return;
        const crop=box.querySelector('.site-video-crop');if(!crop)return;
        const r=crop.getBoundingClientRect();
        if(!r.width||!r.height)return;
        // cover the themed viewport while keeping the iframe's layout viewport at 1280x720
        const scale=Math.max(r.width/1280,r.height/720);
        box.style.setProperty('--sm-hd-scale',String(Math.max(.18,Math.min(2,scale))));
      };
      syncHdScale();
      const hdResizeObserver=('ResizeObserver' in window)?new ResizeObserver(syncHdScale):null;
      try{hdResizeObserver?.observe(box)}catch{}
      const toggle=box.querySelector('[data-vtoggle]');
      toggle.onclick=ev=>{
        ev.stopPropagation();if(!activeVideoReady||!activeVideoPlayer)return;
        try{
          const st=activeVideoPlayer.getPlayerState();
          if(st===YT.PlayerState.PLAYING||st===YT.PlayerState.BUFFERING)activeVideoPlayer.pauseVideo();
          else if(st===YT.PlayerState.ENDED){activeVideoPlayer.seekTo(0,true);activeVideoPlayer.playVideo()}
          else activeVideoPlayer.playVideo();
        }catch{}
      };
      const seek=box.querySelector('[data-vseek]');
      const seekToValue=()=>{if(!activeVideoReady||!activeVideoPlayer||!seek)return;try{activeVideoPlayer.seekTo(Number(seek.value)||0,true);updateVideoProgress(box,activeVideoPlayer)}catch{}finally{activeVideoSeeking=false}};
      if(seek){
        seek.addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>{activeVideoSeeking=true});
        seek.addEventListener('input',()=>{activeVideoSeeking=true;const cur=box.querySelector('[data-vtime]');if(cur)cur.textContent=formatVideoTime(seek.value);const duration=Number(activeVideoPlayer?.getDuration?.())||0;const pct=duration?Math.max(0,Math.min(100,(Number(seek.value)||0)/duration*100)):0;seek.style.setProperty('--seek-fill',pct+'%')});
        seek.addEventListener('change',seekToValue);
        seek.addEventListener('pointerup',seekToValue);
        seek.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{if(['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','Home','End','PageUp','PageDown'].includes(e.key))seekToValue()});
      }
      const fullBtn=box.querySelector('[data-vfull]');
      const fullscreenElement=()=>document.fullscreenElement||document.webkitFullscreenElement||null;
      const syncFullscreenButton=()=>{
        if(!fullBtn)return;
        const isFull=fullscreenElement()===box;
        fullBtn.textContent=isFull?'⛶':'⛶';
        fullBtn.setAttribute('aria-label',isFull?'تصغير الفيديو':'ملء الشاشة');
        fullBtn.title=isFull?'تصغير الفيديو':'ملء الشاشة';
        fullBtn.classList.toggle('is-fullscreen',isFull);
      };
      const requestBoxFullscreen=()=>{
        const fn=box.requestFullscreen||box.webkitRequestFullscreen;
        if(fn)return Promise.resolve(fn.call(box));
        return Promise.reject(new Error('Fullscreen API غير مدعوم'));
      };
      const exitBoxFullscreen=()=>{
        const fn=document.exitFullscreen||document.webkitExitFullscreen;
        if(fn)return Promise.resolve(fn.call(document));
        return Promise.reject(new Error('Fullscreen API غير مدعوم'));
      };
      fullBtn.onclick=async ev=>{
        ev.stopPropagation();
        try{
          if(fullscreenElement()) await exitBoxFullscreen();
          else await requestBoxFullscreen();
        }catch(err){console.warn('Fullscreen toggle failed',err)}
        syncFullscreenButton();
      };
      const onFullscreenChange=()=>syncFullscreenButton();
      document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange',onFullscreenChange);
      document.addEventListener('webkitfullscreenchange',onFullscreenChange);
      syncFullscreenButton();
      const qualityBtn=box.querySelector('[data-vquality]');
      const qualityExit=box.querySelector('[data-vquality-exit]');
      const enterNativeQualityMode=()=>{
        box.classList.add('native-quality-mode');
        qualityBtn?.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');
        try{activeVideoPlayer?.pauseVideo?.()}catch{}
        toast('اختر ⚙ من مشغل YouTube ثم الجودة واختر 720p أو 1080p. بعد الاختيار اضغط «العودة للمشغل».');
      };
      const exitNativeQualityMode=()=>{
        box.classList.remove('native-quality-mode');
        qualityBtn?.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');
        requestAnimationFrame(syncHdScale);
      };
      if(qualityBtn){
        qualityBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');
        qualityBtn.onclick=ev=>{ev.stopPropagation();enterNativeQualityMode()};
      }
      if(qualityExit)qualityExit.onclick=ev=>{ev.stopPropagation();exitNativeQualityMode()};
    }catch(e){
      console.error(e);activeVideoReady=false;
      const load=box.querySelector('.site-video-loading');if(load)load.textContent='تعذر تحميل مشغل الفيديو. حاول تحديث الصفحة.';
    }
  }
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden&&activeVideoReady){try{activeVideoPlayer?.pauseVideo?.()}catch{}}});
  window.addEventListener('beforeunload',stopActiveVideo);

  function page(title,sub,html){app.innerHTML=`<div class="page-enter"><div class="page-title reveal"><h1>${safe(title)}</h1>${sub?`<p>${safe(sub)}</p>`:''}</div><div class="page-body reveal">${html}</div></div>`}
  let revealObserver=null;
  function initDynamicMotion(){
    try{revealObserver?.disconnect?.()}catch{}
    const nodes=$$('.reveal-on-scroll');
    if(!nodes.length)return;
    const reduced=window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')?.matches;
    if(reduced||!('IntersectionObserver' in window)){nodes.forEach(el=>el.classList.add('visible'));return}
    revealObserver=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
      entries.forEach(entry=>{if(entry.isIntersecting){entry.target.classList.add('visible');revealObserver?.unobserve?.(entry.target)}});
    },{threshold:.08,rootMargin:'0px 0px -5% 0px'});
    nodes.forEach(el=>revealObserver.observe(el));
  }
  function route(name){stopActiveVideo();location.hash=name==='home'?'':'#'+name}
  function syncNav(name){$$('.nav-pill,[data-route]',document).forEach(x=>{if(x.closest?.('.nav-more-menu')||x.classList?.contains('nav-pill'))x.classList.toggle('active',x.dataset.route===name)});const more=['schedule','timer','files'].includes(name);$('#navMoreToggle')?.classList.toggle('active',more)}
  function bindGo(){$$('[data-go]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>route(b.dataset.go))}
  $$('.nav-pill,.brand,.nav-more-menu [data-route]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(b.dataset.route)route(b.dataset.route);$('#navMore')?.classList.remove('open');$('#navMoreToggle')?.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false')}));
  $('#mobileMenu').addEventListener('click',()=>$('#navPills').classList.toggle('open'));
  $('#navMoreToggle')?.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();const box=$('#navMore');const open=!box.classList.contains('open');box.classList.toggle('open',open);$('#navMoreToggle').setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open))});
  document.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(!e.target.closest?.('#navMore')){$('#navMore')?.classList.remove('open');$('#navMoreToggle')?.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false')}});
  window.addEventListener('hashchange',render);

  function featureCards(){return tools.map(([r,i,t,d],idx)=>`<button class="feature-card reveal-on-scroll" data-go="${r}" style="text-align:right;color:inherit;transition-delay:${Math.min(idx*35,210)}ms"><div class="iconbox">${i}</div><h3>${safe(t)}</h3><p>${safe(d)}</p><span class="card-arrow">↗</span></button>`).join('')}
  function contentCards(type,items){
    if(!items.length)return ``;
    return `<div class="grid">${items.map(x=>`<article class="content-card"><div class="card-top"><span class="badge ${type==='labs'?'gold':''}">${type==='lectures'?'محاضرة':'Lab'}</span><span class="badge gray">${safe(x.unit||'BTEC')}</span></div><h3>${safe(x.title)}</h3><p>${safe(x.description||'')}</p><div class="meta">${x.instructions?'<span>تعليمات متوفرة</span>':''}${x.youtube_url?'<span>فيديو متوفر</span>':''}</div>${x.youtube_url&&validUrl(x.youtube_url)?`<div style="margin-top:14px"><a class="btn small" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="${safe(x.youtube_url)}">فتح المحاضرة</a></div>`:''}</article>`).join('')}</div>`
  }

  async function home(){

      <section class="hero-sahaba hero-only" id="heroSahaba">
        <div class="hero-copy sahaba-reveal">
          <div class="hero-kicker"><span></span> منصة BTEC الشاملة للطالب</div>

            <div class="verse-mark">﴾</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="hero-character sahaba-reveal" id="heroCharacter">
          <div class="character-glow"></div>
          <div class="character-frame"><img src="data:image/webp;base64,
